purpose: Internal normalized transit model, compatible in structure with GTFS concepts without claiming to be a complete GTFS feed.
rules: Never fabricate stop coordinates: missing coordinates remain null until joined to an official geospatial source.
Never label scheduled journey minutes as realtime ETA.
Every operator dataset must retain a source URL and retrieval date.
Realtime data must be separated from static timetable data.
User reports are evidence, not authoritative timetable data.
